{{Quote|This is ''Valkyrie 2929'', we're comin' up on the drop zone.|[[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]], on Onderon|<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>}}
'''''Valkyrie 2929''''' was a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The ship was piloted by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Hawk/Legends|Hawk]] and was used to transport Kenobi, Skywalker, [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to a location near the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]]' [[Onderon insurgent camp/Legends|camp]] shortly before the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]] began.
